hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site details for every site (Electricity Hookup '30', Water Hookup 'Y' on all electric sites; e.g. https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5492&parkId=552903) + the park notes on every site page ('There are no sewer hookups on any campsites. values.note: The booking site lists 247 sites (the park page says 250): 118 with 30-amp electric and water and 129 without hookups, over Loops 1, 2, 3, 4 North and 4 South. One pull-through (Loop 1); listed driveways run 32-116 ft.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Parkers Creek offers 250 sites for RV, tent and trailer camping; 120 sites have electric and water hookups') + ReserveAmerica site list and every Parkers Creek site page, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loop 1's comfort station (toilets only) is closed until repaired; the bathhouses nearest site 53 are open (October 2026).

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Showers, restrooms, trash containers, and a dump station are conveniently located') + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area alert ('Parkers Creek Loop 1 comfort station (these are toilets only) closed indefinitely until repairs are made. The bathhouses closest to site 53 are open with toilets and showers.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 2027: Loops 2 and 4 North March 1 to November 29, Loop 1 April 5 to November 29, Loop 3 March 1 to November 1, Loop 4 South April 5 to November 1. 2026 ran March 2 to November 30.

season.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area (Operating Season Schedule 2026 and 2027, Parkers Creek Access camping loops), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loops 3, 4 North and 4 South are walk-up only, first come first served. Sites can be booked for today and up to 6 months ahead. Holiday weekends need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552903 (Booking Window, Campsite Electric / Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'; Business Rules for Holiday Weekends: '2 nights Minimum Stay on holiday weekend', '1 night Minimum Stay on holiday weekend if the booking dates within 14 Days before Arrival Date') + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Loops 3 and 4 at Parkers Creek and Loop E at Poplar Point are all walk-up campsites that are available on a first-come, first-served basis'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites without hookups $30 a night and electric/water sites $40, each including the $3-a-night service fee that the booking site adds to its $27 / $37 camping fee (charged on in-person bookings too). Seniors 62+, veterans and military members get $6 off a night with ID at check-in. No out-of-state rate; federal passes are not accepted. Cancelling costs $15 per reservation.

fees.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('RV with electric and water hookups $40'; 'Tent, trailer, or RV site with no hookups $30'; 'All prices listed on this website page include the $3 service fee'; 'A $3 service fee is charged for all reservations, including those made in-person'; 'Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass') + ReserveAmerica price breakdowns https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5547&parkId=552903 (Loop 2 site 058, 2026-11-10: 'Camping Fees (1 night) $27.00 Per Night') and https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5492&parkId=552903 (Loop 1 site 002, 2027-04-13: '$37.00 Per Night') ('Reservation Fees $3.00 Per Night'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass, or passes for other states'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Added 30-amp electric and water with no sewer, 247 sites (118 electric), showers and dump station, March-November season by loop, ReserveAmerica booking with walk-up Loops 3 and 4 (fcfs some_sites; 6-month window, holiday minimum waived within 14 days), $30 / $40 rates and the senior/military discount.
